title: Work and Skills
grammar_title: Grammar: can / can't · Wh- questions (where, when, why, how…)

plan.listen: VOA Lesson 26: This Game Is Fun!
British Council: “Meeting a new team member” (listening)
VOA Lesson 27: I Can't Come In + British Council: “A request from your boss” (listening)

sentences: What do you do? — I'm an accountant.
I work for a big company.
I can use a computer very well.
I can't speak English well — yet!
لا أستطيع التحدث بالإنجليزية جيدًا — حتى الآن!
Why do you want this job?
How long does it take to get to work?
كم من الوقت تستغرق للوصول إلى العمل؟
I have a meeting at ten.

grammar.intro_en:
Question order: Wh-word + do/does + person + verb → Where do you work? What does she do?
With be: Wh-word + is/are + person → Where is your office?
grammar.intro_ar: لا تقل Where you work? — السؤال في الإنجليزية يحتاج do أو does: Where do you work? · وبعد can يأتي الفعل بدون s: He can speak.

rows: Can you cook? — Yes, I can.

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Make sentences with can / can't / Can…? (✓ = can, ✗ = can't, ? = question).
exercises.instructions: Make sentences with can / can't / Can…? (✓ = can, ✗ = can't, ? = question).

exercises.title: Exercise 2 — Choose the question word.
items: 4) ___ do you study English? — Because I need it for my job.
5) ___ is the bus ticket? — Ten pounds.
6) ___ does the meeting take? — One hour.

exercises.title: Exercise 3 — Correct the mistake.
items: 4) I am work in a bank.

write_speak:
Write & Speak — Write 6 sentences about your job (or your dream job): what you do, where, and what you can / can't do.
Example: I am a sales manager. I work for a phone company in Maadi. I start work at nine. I can use a computer and I can speak to customers. I can't speak English very well yet. My colleagues are friendly and helpful.
